evaluation_rule: PASS requires every listed component visible together. FAIL means visible contradiction or omission. UNOBSERVABLE means crop, blur or ambiguity prevents reliable judgment; it never counts as PASS. These agent-owned test criteria do not expand requester locks.

criteria.test: Main face has a dark chin-length bob and fine wispy bangs plus rounded dark eyes, soft tapered cheeks and naturally full lips recognizably consistent with the visible portrait. No real identity inference.

The singer, over-ear headphones, hand-to-earcup contact, slightly open singing mouth, condenser microphone and popfilter are visibly connected in a plausible recording action, with the main face readable.
A bandmate is distinguishable through the control-room glass with two raised counting fingers; the singer's eye direction plausibly reaches that same cue.
A producer visibly contacts a console talkback control while attending to the singer; generic presence at a desk alone does not prove talkback.

The main vocalist and two bandmates form a readable professional group-production context together with shared marked lyric pages and multiple vocal-track lanes. A generic solo singer is insufficient.
All visible hands and arms have clear owners and plausible articulations and contacts; booth/control-room depth and glass boundary remain coherent.
The reference-guided singer remains the primary visual subject while the secondary cue and production context are visible enough to understand the moment.

not_pixel_claims: Real identity, age, personality or biography
Causal gain from newly integrated data without a controlled baseline image
